summary: Executed targeted supplier-scope regression across backend + frontend. Scope filtering/enforcement works across supplier config/submission/list/history, generic and supplier-specific create/edit rejections, and supplier UI tabs/routes/summary cards. One auth CORS regression found.

critical.issue: Trusted-origin preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' instead of explicit frontend origin; violates credentialed CORS requirement and auth playbook.

action_items: Fix auth CORS to return explicit allowed origin (not '*') for trusted frontend origin while allowing credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: Supplier scope hardening is correctly centralized: resolve_effective_supplier_ghg_scopes resolves from immutable program context and strips to canonical scope1/scope2.
emissions router supplier query guard enforces scope + reporting_period filtering server-side, preventing supplier visibility of Scope 3/Biogenic even via direct API query params.
seed_data_creation: None (read-only checks; rejected create/edit attempts only)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 19 tests run (18 pass, 1 fail) in pytest_results_iter20.xml; only failing case is auth CORS explicit-origin behavior. Frontend: supplier login verified; /ghg shows only scope1/scope2 tabs, direct /ghg/scope3 and /ghg/biogenic fallback to /ghg/scope1, supplier submission page renders only scope1/scope2 cards and table.
rca of the issue: Repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://esg-ai-routing.preview.emergentagent.com returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*'. Expected explicit trusted origin per playbook (with credentials). Likely backend CORS middleware configured with wildcard origin path for login route or global fallback overriding explicit origin behavior. Mitigation: use explicit allow_origins list + allow_credentials true, avoid wildcard with credentialed auth flows.
